data.bd_tips.afghan: That long silky coat tangles easily. A gentle brush a few times a week keeps it flowing.
data.bd_tips.akita: Akitas are calm and proud and like their own space. Let them meet new dogs slowly.
data.bd_tips.bichon: That cotton-ball coat keeps growing and tangles. A brush every few days and a trim now and then keep it fluffy.
data.bd_tips.chow: That thick lion coat gets hot and tangly. Brush it often, and keep summer days cool with shade and water.
data.bd_tips.corso: Cane Corsos are big, gentle guardians who love their family. Calm, kind training and early friends keep them relaxed.
data.bd_tips.dane: Giant pups grow fast and their joints need care. Gentle walks while young, and no long runs until fully grown.
data.bd_tips.dobie: Dobermans have short coats and feel the cold. A warm coat on chilly walks and lots of cuddles at home keep them happy.
data.bd_tips.frenchie: Flat faces breathe hard in heat. Short walks, shade and water on warm days.
data.bd_tips.gsd: Shepherds are clever and love a job to do. Games, training and walks keep them happy.
data.bd_tips.lab: Labs love food a little too much. Measure the meals, go easy on treats and keep them moving.
data.bd_tips.malamute: Malamutes wear a thick winter coat all year. Shade and water on warm days, and a good brush when the fluff comes out.
data.bd_tips.maltese: That long silky white coat needs a daily brush. A little topknot keeps the hair out of the eyes.
data.bd_tips.mastiff: Big dogs feel the heat and drool when warm. Shade, water and a towel for that big face.
data.bd_tips.minpin: Min Pins are tiny and fast and fit through small gaps. A good fence and a snug coat in the cold keep them safe.
data.bd_tips.pitbull: Pit Bulls are cuddly, people-loving goofballs with lots of energy. Play, walks and gentle training keep them wiggly and happy.
data.bd_tips.pom: Tiny dogs have delicate knees and windpipes. Use a harness, not a collar, and lift them with both hands.
data.bd_tips.pug: Flat faces breathe hard in heat. Short walks, shade and water on warm days.
data.bd_tips.schnauzer: That wiry beard and those eyebrows need a trim now and then. A quick wipe after meals keeps the beard tidy.
data.bd_tips.shihtzu: Shih Tzus have long hair and short noses. A daily brush, a topknot for the eyes and shade on warm days help a lot.
data.bd_tips.spitz: That white coat sheds in big clouds twice a year. A good brush keeps it soft, and it never needs shaving.
data.bd_tips.stdpoodle: Poodle curls keep growing and never shed. A brush and a regular trim keep them comfy, and a big poodle loves a long walk.
data.bd_tips.westie: Westies can have sensitive skin. A gentle shampoo, a good brush and not too many baths keep it calm.
data.bd_tips.yorkie: Yorkie hair grows long and needs a gentle brush most days. Tiny dogs need a harness and soft hands too.

data.extra_unsafe.alcohol.name: Alcohol
data.extra_unsafe.alcohol.swap: Fresh water is the only drink a pup needs.
data.extra_unsafe.alcohol.why: Alcohol is poisonous to dogs, even a few sips, and can cause wobbling and vomiting.
data.extra_unsafe.caffeine.name: Caffeine
data.extra_unsafe.caffeine.why: Caffeine makes a dog's heart race and can cause tremors.
data.extra_unsafe.leek.name: Leek
data.extra_unsafe.leek.why: Leeks, chives and shallots are in the onion family and damage a dog's red blood cells.
data.extra_unsafe.raw_dough.name: Raw Dough
data.extra_unsafe.raw_dough.swap: Carrot Crunchies are a safe treat.
data.extra_unsafe.raw_dough.why: Raw yeast dough keeps rising in a dog's warm tummy and makes alcohol as it ferments.
data.extra_unsafe.xylitol.name: Xylitol
data.extra_unsafe.xylitol.why: Xylitol drops a dog's blood sugar fast and can harm the liver.

data.food.carrot_sticks.tip: Crunchy and safe raw or cooked. Cut them small for little dogs.
data.food.dog_senbei.note: +5 Hunger, +10 Happiness. A crunchy round rice cracker.
data.food.dog_senbei.tip: A plain rice cracker made for dogs, with no salt and no soy sauce. The ones people eat are far too salty.
data.food.frozen_pupsicle.note: +15 Hunger, +20 Happiness, +10 Energy. Cools a hot dog for 1 game hour.
data.food.frozen_pupsicle.tip: Frozen plain yoghurt and fruit, no xylitol ever. Let it soften a little for small dogs.
data.food.frozen_yoghurt_ghosts.note: +5 Hunger, +15 Happiness, cools the dog. Little frozen ghosts that melt fast.
data.food.frozen_yoghurt_ghosts.tip: Plain yoghurt only, no sugar and no sweetener. Xylitol is poison for dogs, so check the pot every time.
data.food.frozen_yoghurt_snowballs.note: +5 Hunger, +15 Happiness, a little Bond. Round frozen snowballs that crunch, then melt.
data.food.frozen_yoghurt_snowballs.tip: Plain unsweetened yoghurt only, never a sweetened or light pot, which can hide xylitol. Dairy is a treat for dogs, so two or three little snowballs are plenty.
data.food.ghost_biscuits.note: +10 Hunger, +15 Happiness. Oat biscuits with a yoghurt ghost on top.
data.food.ghost_biscuits.tip: Plain oats and plain yoghurt, nothing else. Chocolate is never for dogs, it is poison to them.
data.food.monster_meatball.note: +30 Hunger, +10 Happiness. A turkey meatball with a carrot-slice eye.
data.food.monster_meatball.tip: Plain cooked turkey, no onion or garlic. Grapes and raisins never go near it, they are poison for dogs.
data.food.pumpkin_patch_pupcake.note: +15 Hunger, +20 Happiness. A little pumpkin cake with a yoghurt swirl.
data.food.pumpkin_patch_pupcake.tip: Plain pumpkin, oat flour and plain yoghurt, no sugar. Chocolate never goes in a dog's cake, it is poison to them.
data.food.pumpkin_puree.tip: Plain cooked pumpkin only, never pie filling. It is gentle on tummies.
data.food.pup_kinton.note: +15 Hunger, +15 Happiness. Golden sweet potato mash, for a lucky year.
data.food.pup_kinton.tip: Plain mashed sweet potato, no sugar and no chestnut syrup. Mochi never goes in a dog's bowl, it is far too sticky to swallow safely.
data.food.pupcake.note: +30 Happiness and double Bond for 1 game hour. 1 per day.
data.food.puppy_kibble.note: +30 Hunger. Small soft bites. Puppies under 6 months get +5 Happiness.
data.food.reindeer_crunch.note: +10 Hunger, +10 Happiness, clean teeth. Carrot sticks and apple pieces, a crunchy reindeer supper.
data.food.reindeer_crunch.tip: Carrot and apple, cut small, with the core and every seed taken out. Apple seeds are not safe for dogs, so not one goes in the bag.
data.food.seedless_watermelon_cubes.tip: Seedless and rind-free only. The rind can block a tummy.
data.food.snow_day_stew.note: +30 Hunger, +10 Happiness. Chicken, carrot and green beans, cooked soft.
data.food.snow_day_stew.tip: Lean chicken with no skin and no bones. Gravy and fatty leftovers upset a dog's tummy, so they stay on the people plates.
data.food.snowflake_oat_cookies.note: +10 Hunger, +10 Happiness, a little Bond. Oat cookies cut like snowflakes.
data.food.snowflake_oat_cookies.tip: Rolled oats, egg and pumpkin, baked plain. Festive cookies often hide macadamia nuts, which make dogs wobbly and ill, so these have none.
data.food.sweet_potato_bones.note: +20 Hunger, +5 Happiness, clean teeth. Baked bone shapes to crunch.
data.food.sweet_potato_bones.tip: Baked plain sweet potato, never raw and never buttered. Nutmeg and other baking spices stay in the kitchen, they make dogs ill.
data.food.sweet_potato_chews.tip: Always cooked and plain, never raw. Raw sweet potato is hard to digest.
data.food.sweet_potato_coins.note: +15 Hunger, +5 Happiness, clean teeth. Chewy little rounds.
data.food.sweet_potato_coins.tip: Baked soft and plain, never raw. Let them cool before the first bite.
data.food.sweet_potato_strip.note: +10 Hunger, +10 Happiness. A chewy Asakusa favourite, made for dogs.
data.food.sweet_potato_strip.tip: Steamed and dried plain sweet potato, nothing added. Cut it into small strips so it is not a choking piece.
data.food.turkey_cranberry_bites.note: +20 Hunger, +15 Happiness. Little turkey bites, each with a fresh cranberry on top.
data.food.turkey_cranberry_bites.tip: Plain cooked turkey with no skin, bones, gravy or seasoning, and just a few fresh cranberries. Cranberry sauce is full of sugar, so only the fresh berries go in.
data.food.turkey_meatballs.note: +45 Hunger, +10 Happiness. Sunday dinner, dog edition.
data.food.turkey_meatballs.tip: Plain cooked turkey, no onion or garlic. Those are poison for dogs.
data.food.warm_bone_broth.note: +10 Hunger, +10 Happiness, +5 Energy, warm paws for an hour.
data.food.warm_bone_broth.tip: Plain and strained, no onion, garlic or salt. Cooked bones can splinter, so none stay in the cup.
data.food.warm_carob_cup.note: +5 Hunger, +15 Happiness, warm paws for an hour. Looks like cocoa. Is not cocoa.
data.food.warm_carob_cup.tip: Carob is safe for dogs and only looks like cocoa. Real cocoa and chocolate are poison to them, so the mugs never get mixed up.

data.greet_lines.akita: You are back. Good. Now everything is as it should be.
data.greet_lines.beagle: AROOO! I smelled you coming from the corner! What did you eat?

data.greet_lines.golden: You came back! Best day! Again!
data.greet_lines.greyhound: *soft roo* You are home. I will lean on you now.
data.greet_lines.gsd: You are home! I checked the garden. All clear. Hello!
data.greet_lines.husky: AWOO! Where were you! Tell me everything! AWOO!
data.greet_lines.lab: You are back! Did you bring a ball? A snack? Both? Hello!
data.greet_lines.malamute: Woo-woo! Where were you? I have so much to tell you. Woo!
data.greet_lines.maltese: You are home. I floated to the door. Please admire the entrance.
data.greet_lines.mastiff: *slow wag* You are home. I will lean on you now. All of me.
data.greet_lines.minpin: YIP! You are back! Look at my knees! Prance, prance!
data.greet_lines.mutt: You came back. I knew you would. Hi.
data.greet_lines.pitbull: YOU ARE HOME! Wiggle wiggle wiggle! Hug! Hug! HUG!
data.greet_lines.pom: YIP YIP YIP! You are home! I spun three times! I will do four!
data.greet_lines.poodle: You are back. I knew the time to the minute.
data.greet_lines.pug: *snort* You are back. Lap, please. Right now.
data.greet_lines.samoyed: Woo-woo! You are home! Look at my smile!
data.greet_lines.schnauzer: Who goes there? Oh. You. Welcome home. The beard is pleased.
data.greet_lines.shiba: Oh. You are back. I did not notice. (Tail: wagging.)
data.greet_lines.shihtzu: *yawn* You are home. Good. Lap, please. I will nap there.
data.greet_lines.spitz: You are back! Look at my fluff! I fluffed it just for you!
data.greet_lines.stdpoodle: Welcome home. I have learned a new trick. Would you like to see it?
data.greet_lines.westie: You are back! I dug you a welcome hole! It is in the flowers!
data.greet_lines.yorkie: Finally. You are late. I forgive you. Pick me up.

data.hm_decor.ball_pit.story: A soft round pit full of bright balls. Jumping in is allowed, and so is lying very still.
data.hm_decor.bird_bath.story: A stone bowl on a pedestal for the garden birds. The sparrows splash in it every morning and the dogs watch, very politely.
data.hm_decor.boston_fern.story: A big leafy fern on a little wooden stand. Boston ferns are safe around dogs, which is why this one was picked.
data.hm_decor.braided_rag_rug.story: A round rug braided from old shirts and one sock. It is the warmest spot on the floor at four o'clock.
data.hm_decor.candy_cane_fairy_lights.st: Red-and-white striped bulbs on a green wire. After dark the fence looks like a row of sweets.
data.hm_decor.cardboard_black_cat.story: A cardboard cat painted black, with a big smile. The dogs sniff it every morning, just in case.
data.hm_decor.cauldron_planter.story: A black pot on stubby legs, full of sunflowers and pansies. Both are safe for dogs to sniff.
data.hm_decor.cuckoo_clock.story: A carved wooden clock with a little bird inside. On the hour it pops out, and every dog in the house answers it.
data.hm_decor.cushion_pile.story: Six squashy cushions in a heap. Officially for people, unofficially for dogs.
data.hm_decor.dog_play_tower.story: Three carpet steps, a cubby hole and a rope to bat. The top step belongs to whoever got there first.
data.hm_decor.doggy_ramp.story: Paw prints lead all the way up. Nobody has needed the ramp yet, but everyone is proud of it.
data.hm_decor.family_photo_frame.story: Everyone who ever shared this yard is on the fence. The ugly ones are the best.
data.hm_decor.felt_fir_tree.story: A soft felt fir in a pot, hung with paper stars the size of a paw. Felt, because real fir needles can upset a dog's tummy.
data.hm_decor.felt_holly_wreath.story: A round wreath of felt leaves and red felt berries. Real holly berries make dogs ill, so these ones are felt.
data.hm_decor.flower_barrel.story: An old wooden barrel full of sunflowers and snapdragons. Both are safe for dogs, who sniff every single one.
data.hm_decor.friendly_fence_web.story: A wobbly crayon web with a round little spider in a bow. She waves at every dog who passes.
data.hm_decor.friendly_scarecrow.story: A pumpkin head and a big grin. The crows sit on his arms to chat.
data.hm_decor.garden_bench.story: A painted wooden bench with room for one person and three dogs. The dogs always get the good end.
data.hm_decor.ghost_garland.story: Little cloth ghosts holding hands. They say boo very quietly.
data.hm_decor.ghost_lantern_string.story: Little paper ghost lanterns on a string. After dark they glow softly, and each one smiles.
data.hm_decor.giant_crayon_box.story: Every crayon is taller than a dog. Nobody has ever finished colouring.
data.hm_decor.hammock.story: A striped hammock between two posts. It swings in the breeze and nobody has ever got out of it gracefully.
data.hm_decor.jack_o_lantern_trio.story: Three pumpkins, three faces, all of them smiling. They glow a little after dark.
data.hm_decor.kadomatsu_pair.story: Bamboo, pine and plum by the gate to welcome the new year's luck. The dogs sniff it every morning to check the luck is still there.
data.hm_decor.lucky_cat.story: A white maneki-neko with one paw raised to wave good luck in. The dogs wave back, in their own way.
data.hm_decor.moon_lamp.story: A round paper moon on a little wooden stand. It glows after dark, so nobody trips over a sleeping dog.
data.hm_decor.paper_bat_bunting.story: Paper bats on a string, cut a bit wonky. They flutter whenever a dog runs past.
data.hm_decor.paper_snowflake_garland.st: Paper snowflakes cut by the Nguyen kids, no two the same. Some of them are dogs, if you squint.
data.hm_decor.patchwork_quilt.story: A quilt hung on the wall, one square for every dog who ever lived here. There is plenty of room for more squares.
data.hm_decor.paw_print_pictures.story: Three little frames, each with one muddy paw print. The artists signed them by sitting on them.
data.hm_decor.present_pile.story: Three wrapped boxes with big bows. They are empty, but every dog checks, every single day.
data.hm_decor.pumpkin_fairy_lights.story: Tiny pumpkin bulbs on a green wire. They light up the fence when the sun goes down.
data.hm_decor.pumpkin_lantern.story: A round pumpkin lantern on a little post. It glows softly after dark.
data.hm_decor.red_wooden_sled.story: A red sled for leaning on the fence. Nobody has ever pulled it, because a dog is always sitting in it.
data.hm_decor.rocking_chair.story: A dog-sized chair with a knitted blanket. Mum likes a rock here after a long day of puppies.
data.hm_decor.sandbox.story: A wooden box of soft sand with a little spade. The one place in the yard where digging gets a round of applause.
data.hm_decor.sofa_ramp.story: A carpeted ramp up to a cushioned top step. Short legs, long backs and old knees all get up without a jump.
data.hm_decor.star_lantern.story: A paper star on a wooden post, with little holes cut in it. After dark it glows and puts stars on the snow.
data.hm_decor.stepping_stones.story: Five flat stones in a wobbly line across the grass. Every dog hops them in a different order.
data.hm_decor.string_lights.story: Little round bulbs on a long wire. They come on by themselves when it gets dark, which looks like magic but is a timer.
data.hm_decor.toy_basket.story: A wicker basket of squeaky friends. Every toy comes out and not one of them ever goes back in.
data.hm_decor.tunnel_sofa.story: A squashy little sofa with a tunnel straight through the middle. Dogs go in one end and come out the other, very pleased with themselves.
data.hm_decor.wind_chime.story: Bamboo tubes and a little wooden bird that clink in the breeze. The dogs tilt their heads at every note.
data.hm_decor.window_seat.story: A cushioned seat under a little round window. The best place in the house to watch the postman and the birds.
data.hm_decor.yard_snowman.story: Lumpy, a bit lopsided, with a carrot nose and a knitted scarf. He waves with his longer arm.

data.houses.gingerbread_kennel.note: A little brown house with white icing on the roof and gumdrops by the door. A look, not a snack: it is wood all the way through.
data.houses.lighthouse_kennel.note: The lamp turns at night. Ships are confused.
data.houses.little_tea_house.note: A teapot on the roof. The dog does not drink tea. The teapot is for guests.
data.houses.pumpkin_cottage.note: Round orange walls and a leaf for a roof. Smells faintly of pie.
data.houses.rocket_ship.note: Countdown painted on the side. Launch is cancelled, forever, for naps.
data.houses.royal_castle_kennel.note: Cardboard turrets. Fit for royalty, or a very good boy.
data.houses.snow_igloo.note: Cool and cozy. Huskies get double the bonus.
data.houses.treehouse_den.note: Has a ladder. Dogs cannot climb ladders. Details.

data.place_lines.bichon.river: The water is lovely. I will watch it. I will not get my puff wet.
data.place_lines.bichon.woods: Bounce, bounce, leaf. Bounce, bounce, stick. This is a great game.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.beach: The waves keep coming back. I keep yelling. It is working.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.house: Sofa secured. Window secured. Toaster under observation.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.market: I will guard the door. From everyone. Forever.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.park: Every dog here is twelve times my size. I will bark at all of them.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.river: The ducks are a threat. I have informed them.
data.place_lines.chihuahua.woods: A leaf moved. I have filed a report.
data.place_lines.chow.beach: Thick coat, warm sand. Shade and water, please. Then admire me.
data.place_lines.chow.house: I have chosen this cushion. It is mine. You may sit near it.
data.place_lines.chow.market: Many people. I will stay by your leg and look unimpressed. It suits me.
data.place_lines.chow.park: I will observe the park from here. Do not take it personally.
data.place_lines.chow.river: Water. Interesting. I will watch it from a dignified distance.
data.place_lines.chow.woods: A calm forest and a calm lion. We approve of each other.
data.place_lines.collie.beach: The waves keep leaving. I keep bringing them back.
data.place_lines.collie.house: Everyone is in the kitchen. I have checked. Twice.
data.place_lines.collie.market: I will keep the shoppers together. Nobody wanders off.
data.place_lines.collie.park: So many dogs. None of them in a line. I can fix that.
data.place_lines.collie.river: The ducks are in a group. Good ducks.
data.place_lines.collie.woods: Every tree is accounted for. I counted.
data.place_lines.corgi.beach: Sand zoomies! My legs are perfect for sand!
data.place_lines.corgi.house: Is that the kitchen? I smell the kitchen.
data.place_lines.corgi.market: Kibble Corner smells AMAZING from here.
data.place_lines.corgi.river: The ducks have bread. I want the bread.
data.place_lines.corso.beach: The sea is big. I am bigger. We are both calm about it.
data.place_lines.corso.house: This is my house. I am its calm, large guardian. Sit anywhere. Not there.
data.place_lines.corso.market: I will stay close. Anyone nice may say hello. Slowly.
data.place_lines.corso.park: I will stand in the middle and be a friendly wall. Visitors welcome.
data.place_lines.corso.river: Slow water, slow dog. We understand each other.
data.place_lines.corso.woods: A quiet path. I will walk in front of you. Just in case.
data.place_lines.dachs.beach: Infinite sand. Infinite digging. I am home.
data.place_lines.dachs.house: Under the sofa is a whole other world.
data.place_lines.dachs.market: I will sniff every shop door. Twice.
data.place_lines.dachs.park: Something is buried under this bench. I know it.
data.place_lines.dachs.river: The mud here is premium mud.
data.place_lines.dachs.woods: I could dig here for a hundred years.
data.place_lines.dane.beach: So much sand. I will lie in a long line of it.
data.place_lines.dane.house: The sofa fits half of me. The other half is on the floor. It is fine.
data.place_lines.dane.market: I can see over every stall. Everything looks tasty from up here.
data.place_lines.dane.park: Hello, small dogs. Hello. Down there. I will be careful.
data.place_lines.dane.river: The water only reaches my knees. I feel tall. I am tall.
data.place_lines.dane.woods: Low branches again. I am sorry, trees.
data.place_lines.dobie.beach: Wide open sand. I can see everything. I may need my coat soon.
data.place_lines.dobie.house: I have checked every window. Now I will lie where I can see all the doors.
data.place_lines.dobie.market: I will stand by the door and look serious. Then I will accept a pat.
data.place_lines.dobie.park: I will patrol the whole park once. Then I will lean on a friend.
data.place_lines.dobie.river: Water, mud, ducks. I am on watch. The ducks are on notice.
data.place_lines.dobie.woods: Every rustle is under review. So far it is only squirrels.
data.place_lines.frenchie.beach: Hot sand, flat face. Shade, please. *snort*
data.place_lines.frenchie.house: Sofa. Cushion. Your foot. All good seats.
data.place_lines.frenchie.market: I will sit on your foot while you shop.
data.place_lines.frenchie.park: I walked to the bench. Now I sit on the bench.
data.place_lines.frenchie.river: I do not swim. I sink. I will watch from here.
data.place_lines.frenchie.woods: Nice and shady. My kind of walk.
data.place_lines.golden.beach: The waves keep coming back to play with me!
data.place_lines.golden.house: Couch! Rug! Lamp! I love the house!
data.place_lines.golden.market: Everyone here is my best friend.
data.place_lines.golden.park: So many friends! So many balls!
data.place_lines.golden.river: WATER! Can I swim? I am swimming. In my mind.
data.place_lines.golden.woods: Sticks! The whole place is sticks!
data.place_lines.greyhound.beach: A whole beach of runway! ZOOM. ...zzz.
data.place_lines.greyhound.house: Found the softest spot. Lying on it upside down now.
data.place_lines.greyhound.market: I will lean on your legs while you shop. All of my weight.
data.place_lines.greyhound.park: So much space. Must... sprint... once. Okay, done. Nap.
data.place_lines.greyhound.river: Long legs, shallow water. I am basically a heron.
data.place_lines.greyhound.woods: Trees are just things I go around at 45 mph.
data.place_lines.gsd.beach: The sand is flat and the ball is round. Throw it.
data.place_lines.gsd.house: I have checked every room. All is in order. Reporting.
data.place_lines.gsd.market: I will stand by you. Anyone suspicious will be sniffed.
data.place_lines.gsd.park: So many dogs and so many jobs. I will start with the ball.
data.place_lines.gsd.river: I will patrol the bank. Nothing is wrong. Still patrolling.
data.place_lines.gsd.woods: Trails! Scents! Tasks! Everything is a task!
data.place_lines.husky.beach: Too much sun, not enough snow. AWOO anyway.
data.place_lines.husky.park: AWOO at every dog in the park! Hello!
data.place_lines.husky.river: The river is singing. I will sing back. AWOO.
data.place_lines.husky.woods: This is wolf territory. I am the wolf.
data.place_lines.lab.beach: Waves AND a ball AND you? Is it my birthday?
data.place_lines.lab.house: The kitchen is that way. I am not going. I am just standing near it.
data.place_lines.lab.market: Kibble Corner smells so good. I am being very patient. Very. Patient.
data.place_lines.lab.park: Balls! Friends! More balls! I might burst with joy.
data.place_lines.lab.river: WATER! I was born for this! Splash splash splash!
data.place_lines.lab.woods: Sticks! Puddles! Mud! A perfect day. Do you have a snack?
data.place_lines.malamute.beach: Sun, sand and a thick coat. Shade and water, please. Woo.
data.place_lines.malamute.house: Indoors is warm. Woo. Can we go somewhere with snow? Woo-woo.
data.place_lines.malamute.market: Woo-woo! I am telling the whole market about my day.
data.place_lines.malamute.park: Hello, park! Woo-woo! That was a long hello. I have more.
data.place_lines.malamute.river: Cold water! My favourite kind! I will dig a hole in it.
data.place_lines.malamute.woods: This is the best digging ground. I will tell you all about it. Woo.
data.place_lines.maltese.beach: The sand is rough on silk. I will watch it from your lap.
data.place_lines.maltese.house: A soft cushion and a window. I will lie on both. Gracefully.
data.place_lines.maltese.market: A small dog in a long white coat. I will wait by you and look lovely.
data.place_lines.maltese.park: I will float around the park. Please notice the silk.
data.place_lines.maltese.river: Water near my fringe. I will admire it from your arms.
data.place_lines.maltese.woods: The leaves are very big. I am a small white cloud among them.
data.place_lines.mastiff.beach: Warm sand and a big sigh. That is the whole plan.
data.place_lines.mastiff.house: Sofa. Mine. It now has a mastiff on it. The dent stays.
data.place_lines.mastiff.market: I will wait here. Please step over my feet. They are big.
data.place_lines.mastiff.park: I will sit here and be a friendly hill. Visitors welcome.
data.place_lines.mastiff.woods: Shade and a log. The log is a pillow now.
data.place_lines.minpin.beach: The sand is cold on my toes. I will zoom until they warm up.
data.place_lines.minpin.house: I have checked the sofa, the window and the sock. I found the sock.
data.place_lines.minpin.market: Carry me in your coat and I will supervise the whole market from there.
data.place_lines.minpin.park: I am prancing. Everyone please notice the prancing. High knees!
data.place_lines.minpin.river: The river is long and I am quick. I will race it. I lose. I race again.
data.place_lines.minpin.woods: Tiny dog, huge forest. Everything is a gap I can fit through.
data.place_lines.mutt.beach: I found a shell. It is for you.
data.place_lines.mutt.house: Can I lie on your feet? Thank you.
data.place_lines.mutt.market: I will wait right here for you. Promise.
data.place_lines.mutt.park: I like it here. Can we stay a bit?
data.place_lines.mutt.river: The water sounds nice. Like you.
data.place_lines.pitbull.beach: Sand zoomies! The wagging makes even more sand!
data.place_lines.pitbull.house: Sofa! Blanket! You! This is the best room and I am wiggling all of it.
data.place_lines.pitbull.market: Hello, shop! Hello, shopper! Hello, other shopper! Hug?
data.place_lines.pitbull.park: So many new friends! I have not met them yet but I love every one!
data.place_lines.pitbull.river: Splash! My whole back half is wagging in the water!
data.place_lines.pitbull.woods: Sticks and smells and you! My three favourite things!
data.place_lines.pom.beach: The sand is deep. I am a very fluffy ship.
data.place_lines.pom.house: Tiny dog, huge sofa. I am the king of it.
data.place_lines.pom.market: Carry me and I will tell the shops what to do.
data.place_lines.pom.park: Every dog here is bigger than me. I will still lead.
data.place_lines.pom.river: The water is big and I am small. Yip. I will watch from your arms.
data.place_lines.pom.woods: I am the size of a leaf. A very bossy leaf.
data.place_lines.poodle.beach: Sand gets into curls and never leaves. I am being brave.
data.place_lines.poodle.house: I have chosen the good cushion. Obviously.
data.place_lines.poodle.market: I would like to see the Boutique. For research.
data.place_lines.poodle.park: The other dogs run in circles. I run in shapes.
data.place_lines.poodle.river: I will admire the water. I will not enter the water. The hair.
data.place_lines.poodle.woods: Twigs in my curls. This is a crisis.
data.place_lines.pug.beach: Sand is just a big warm bed. Goodnight.
data.place_lines.pug.market: Kibble Corner. Kibble. Corner. snort snort.
data.place_lines.pug.park: I walked here. That counts as exercise. Can we sit?
data.place_lines.pug.river: The ducks have bread. I am also bread-shaped. We are allies.
data.place_lines.pug.woods: Too many trees. Not enough benches. snort.
data.place_lines.samoyed.beach: Too warm for me. I will smile from the shade.
data.place_lines.samoyed.house: The sofa is now fluffier. That is me. I am on it.
data.place_lines.samoyed.market: Hello, shop. Hello, person. Hello, other person. Woo!
data.place_lines.samoyed.park: Everyone here gets a smile. Even the pigeon.
data.place_lines.samoyed.river: Cold water is my favourite water. Woo-woo!
data.place_lines.samoyed.woods: The shade is nice. The leaves stick to me. I am a leaf dog now.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.beach: Sand in the beard. I will be a very gritty philosopher.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.house: I have checked every room. The beard approves.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.market: I will guard the door. The eyebrows will do the rest.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.park: Ten dogs, four leaves and a pigeon. I will report on all of them.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.river: Ducks. I have notes. Many notes.
data.place_lines.schnauzer.woods: A rustle! A twig! A squirrel! This is an emergency. A happy one.
data.place_lines.shiba.beach: Sand in my curl. This is a crisis.
data.place_lines.shiba.house: The sofa is mine now. I have decided.
data.place_lines.shiba.market: I will wait outside. Like royalty.
data.place_lines.shiba.park: Other dogs may admire me from a distance.
data.place_lines.shiba.river: The ducks are staring. I am staring harder.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.beach: Hot sand, short nose. Shade and water, please. Then a nap.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.house: The sofa is soft. The sun is warm. I am not moving. Goodnight.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.market: I will ride in your arms and wave at the shops with my top-knot.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.park: I walked to a bench. I sat on the bench. That was the whole walk.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.river: Water. Ducks. Shade. I will watch from the nicest spot.
data.place_lines.shihtzu.woods: Shady and quiet. My kind of walk. Wake me if there is a snack.
data.place_lines.spitz.beach: Sand sticks to fluff. I am a beige dog now. Hello!
data.place_lines.spitz.house: The sofa is white. I am white. We match.
data.place_lines.spitz.market: Hello, shop! Do you like my coat? Everyone does.
data.place_lines.spitz.park: Look at me! Look at my fluff! Hello, everyone!
data.place_lines.spitz.river: Splashy! I will go close. Not too close. The fluff.
data.place_lines.spitz.woods: A sunny patch! I will stand in it and sparkle.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.beach: Long legs, long beach. I could run to the horizon. Gracefully.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.house: I have chosen the best chair. The Miniature Poodle may have the second best.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.market: The Boutique! My cousin the Miniature Poodle recommends it. Strongly.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.park: I will run a few elegant laps. Then I will learn a trick, for fun.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.river: A paddle! Poodles were water dogs once. I remember. Mostly.
data.place_lines.stdpoodle.woods: Twigs in the topknot. I will be brave about it.
data.place_lines.westie.beach: Sand is just dry mud. I will dig it. Hello, sand.
data.place_lines.westie.house: Sofa, cushion, dig in the cushion. Why not? It is a good cushion.
data.place_lines.westie.market: I will march along the shops like a tiny white chrysanthemum on a mission.
data.place_lines.westie.park: Hello, everyone! I am a very small white dog with very large plans.
data.place_lines.westie.river: A muddy bank. I will dig. Tomorrow I will be white again. Probably.
data.place_lines.westie.woods: A hole! Somebody dug a hole. I will make it bigger.
data.place_lines.yorkie.beach: Sand and silk are not friends. Hold me and I will look at it.
data.place_lines.yorkie.house: The sofa is mine. The cushion is mine. You may sit on the floor.
data.place_lines.yorkie.market: Carry me and I will supervise. Put me down and I will still supervise.
data.place_lines.yorkie.park: Big dogs everywhere. I will stroll straight through. They will move.
data.place_lines.yorkie.river: Water is wet. I have decided I do not love that. Carry me, please.
data.place_lines.yorkie.woods: Leaves in the silk. I will allow it. Briefly.

data.sig.afghan.say: Note the flow. Note the shine. Do not note the knots.
data.sig.akita.say: I will wait here. I am very good at waiting.
data.sig.bichon.say: Boing, boing, spin. I am a cloud with a very happy tail.
data.sig.chow.say: Behold the mane. Do not touch the mane. Just behold.
data.sig.collie.say: I am herding you with my eyes. Please sit.
data.sig.corso.say: *leans slowly* This is how a guardian hugs. Please do not move.
data.sig.dachs.say: Wiggle wiggle. The back half is late.
data.sig.dane.say: A bow. From very high up. Sorry about the ceiling.
data.sig.dobie.say: Perimeter checked. Threat level: cuddle. You may approach.
data.sig.frenchie.say: Back legs out. Belly on the cool floor. Perfect.
data.sig.greyhound.say: 45 mph. Now I need a 20-hour nap.
data.sig.gsd.say: Ready. Alert. Waiting for orders. Any orders. Even snacks.
data.sig.lab.say: Is it dinner? Is it dinner? It is dinner. I knew it.
data.sig.malamute.say: Woo-woo-WOO! That was a speech. You may applaud.
data.sig.maltese.say: A gentle bow and a swish of silk. Applause may be quiet.
data.sig.mastiff.say: Down I go. Slowly. All of me. Please wait.
data.sig.minpin.say: Knees up. Chin up. I am a very small horse.
data.sig.pitbull.say: The whole back half is wagging. I cannot stop it. Come here for a hug.
data.sig.pom.say: Spin, yip, spin. That is my whole act and it is perfect.
data.sig.poodle.say: Note the footwork. Note the pom-poms.
data.sig.samoyed.say: Woo-woo! That was the smile. Now with sound.
data.sig.schnauzer.say: I raised my eyebrows. That means I saw you. And the leaf.
data.sig.shiba.say: I have died. Bury me in pâté.
data.sig.shihtzu.say: The top-knot stays up. The rest of me is a rug. Goodnight, court.
data.sig.spitz.say: Look at the fluff. Now look at the fluff from the side.
data.sig.stdpoodle.say: A full turn on long legs. The Miniature Poodle is taking notes.
data.sig.westie.say: Dig, dig, dance. Where did the dirt go? Everywhere. Ta-da.
data.sig.yorkie.say: I am small and I am a star. The bow stays on. Always.

data.tfood.golden_bone.note: Treasure. +60 Bond and Glowing for a whole game day.
data.tfood.wild_berries.note: Treasure. +15 Hunger, +10 Energy. On a walk: +15 seconds.
data.tg_miss.0: {n} sniffed the air, sat on nothing, and looked proud anyway.
data.tg_miss.1: {n} followed the treat for a bit, then remembered a very important leaf.
data.tg_miss.2: Close! {n} invented a brand new trick. Nobody knows what it is.
data.tg_miss.3: {n} is now facing the wrong way and very pleased about it.
data.tk_care.asakusa: Some temples and shrines only welcome dogs in a carrier. Check the sign at the gate first.
data.tk_care.odaiba: Sea water is salty, so it is not for drinking. Bring fresh water and rinse paws after the beach.
data.tk_care.ride: On real trains in Japan, dogs ride in a closed carrier. In the game, everyone squeezes in by the window.
data.tk_care.shibuya: Busy crossings are loud for dogs. Keep the lead short and cross at a quiet moment.
data.tk_care.tokyotower: City pavements get hot in summer. Touch the ground with your hand, and walk early or late.
data.tk_care.ueno: Picnic food is for people, not dogs. Bring their own treats and fresh water.
data.tk_care.yoyogi: Dog runs have their own rules, like leads off only inside the fence. Stay close and watch the play.
data.tk_fortunes.0: Great luck! Naps will be long and sunny.
data.tk_fortunes.1: Great luck! A new friend is waiting around the next corner.
data.tk_fortunes.2: Good luck! Every stick found this week will be the best stick.
data.tk_fortunes.3: Great luck! The softest cushion in the house will be free when you want it.
data.tk_fortunes.4: Small luck, which is still luck! Your tail will wag at least a hundred times today.
data.tk_fortunes.5: Great luck! Someone you love will say good dog many times today.
data.tk_lines.afghan.asakusa: An old temple and a dog with very old style. We match.
data.tk_lines.afghan.odaiba: Sea wind in my coat. Somebody will brush it later. Right?
data.tk_lines.afghan.shibuya: The crossing breeze is perfect for my hair. Everyone is looking. Good.
data.tk_lines.afghan.tokyotower: Tall, slim and a little dramatic. The tower and I get along.
data.tk_lines.afghan.ueno: Lotus leaves on the pond, wind in my hair. Very elegant.
data.tk_lines.afghan.yoyogi: A lawn this big deserves one elegant gallop. Then a long rest.
data.tk_lines.akita.asakusa: An old temple, a calm crowd. I feel at home here.
data.tk_lines.akita.odaiba: The sea is calm today. So am I. Mostly.
data.tk_lines.akita.shibuya: Hachikō was an Akita like me. I will sit with him a while.
data.tk_lines.akita.tokyotower: The tower stands still and tall. So do I.
data.tk_lines.akita.ueno: The pond is quiet and still. I can wait here. I am good at waiting.
data.tk_lines.akita.yoyogi: I will stay near the gate and keep watch. That is my kind of play.
data.tk_lines.beagle.asakusa: Rice crackers, sweet potato, incense. My nose is on a temple trip.
data.tk_lines.beagle.odaiba: Seaweed, sunscreen and a hot dog stand on a bridge. AROOO!
data.tk_lines.beagle.shibuya: A thousand people and every one of them had breakfast. AROOO.
data.tk_lines.beagle.tokyotower: I can smell the whole city from here. Mostly noodles.
data.tk_lines.beagle.ueno: Somebody has a picnic. Somebody else has a picnic. Everybody has a picnic.
data.tk_lines.beagle.yoyogi: Every dog here smells different. I need to sniff all of them.
data.tk_lines.bichon.asakusa: A red lantern and a white puff. A perfect photo! Boing!
data.tk_lines.bichon.odaiba: Sand on my puff. I am a sugar cookie now. Boing!
data.tk_lines.bichon.shibuya: Boing! Boing! So many people! Everybody gets a bounce!
data.tk_lines.bichon.tokyotower: A tall tower and a small cloud. The cloud did a spin.
data.tk_lines.bichon.ueno: Ducks on the pond and a puff on the grass. Boing, boing, duck!
data.tk_lines.bichon.yoyogi: So many dogs! I am a cloud among friends! Boing!
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.asakusa: That lantern looks dangerous. I am keeping an eye on it.
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.odaiba: The waves keep coming. I keep telling them off. City waves are rude.
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.shibuya: So many people. I will bark at the crossing. The crossing is not listening.
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.tokyotower: That tower is very tall. I am taller on the inside.
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.ueno: A swan boat looked at me. I have informed it who is in charge.
data.tk_lines.chihuahua.yoyogi: Twelve big dogs and me. I am in charge of all of them.
data.tk_lines.chow.asakusa: A thousand-year-old temple. Finally, something as dignified as me.
data.tk_lines.chow.odaiba: Warm sand on a thick coat. Shade and water, please. Then admiration.
data.tk_lines.chow.shibuya: So many people. I will walk through with my head high. They will make room.
data.tk_lines.chow.tokyotower: Red and tall. A lion approves of a landmark.
data.tk_lines.chow.ueno: A quiet pond and a shady tree. This suits the lion.
data.tk_lines.chow.yoyogi: Many dogs. I will observe them from this spot. One may approach. Slowly.
data.tk_lines.collie.asakusa: The stalls are in a neat line. Somebody here understands.
data.tk_lines.collie.odaiba: The boats keep leaving the bay. I keep counting them back.
data.tk_lines.collie.shibuya: Everyone crosses at once. In all directions. Nobody told me.
data.tk_lines.collie.tokyotower: Every street from up there would look like a line. Lovely.
data.tk_lines.collie.ueno: The ducks on the pond are in a little row. Good ducks.
data.tk_lines.collie.yoyogi: Twenty dogs and no line. I have work to do.
data.tk_lines.corgi.asakusa: The snack street! Do they have dog snacks? They have dog snacks!
data.tk_lines.corgi.odaiba: Beach zoomies, city edition! My legs were made for this.
data.tk_lines.corgi.shibuya: So many people! Someone here has a snack. I can feel it.
data.tk_lines.corgi.tokyotower: From up there you could see every snack in Tokyo.
data.tk_lines.corgi.ueno: Ducks on the pond, picnics on the grass. Nobody is sharing. Yet.
data.tk_lines.corgi.yoyogi: A whole lawn of friends! And a picnic over there. Hello, picnic.
data.tk_lines.corso.asakusa: A calm old temple. I like calm old things. We understand each other.
data.tk_lines.corso.odaiba: The sea is big. I am big. We nod at each other.
data.tk_lines.corso.shibuya: So many people. I will walk close and slow. They can go around.
data.tk_lines.corso.tokyotower: A big tower for a big dog. A good match.
data.tk_lines.corso.ueno: A shady tree by the pond. I will guard it. Peacefully.
data.tk_lines.corso.yoyogi: Small dogs, big dogs. I will be a calm hill in the middle.
data.tk_lines.dachs.asakusa: The snack street smells amazing. I will sniff every stall from the path.
data.tk_lines.dachs.odaiba: City sand! I could tunnel to the other side of the bay.
data.tk_lines.dachs.shibuya: Too many feet up here. I will investigate the ground.
data.tk_lines.dachs.tokyotower: Under the tower is the best spot. Nobody digs there. Yet.
data.tk_lines.dachs.ueno: So many smells along the pond path. I will check every single one.
data.tk_lines.dachs.yoyogi: This lawn has never been dug. That feels like a missed chance.
data.tk_lines.dane.asakusa: That lantern is nearly my size. Nearly.
data.tk_lines.dane.odaiba: Big beach, big dog. A good fit.
data.tk_lines.dane.shibuya: I am the tallest thing at the crossing that is not a building.
data.tk_lines.dane.tokyotower: Finally, something taller than me. I respect it.
data.tk_lines.dane.ueno: I tried to sit on the picnic blanket. I am the picnic blanket now.
data.tk_lines.dane.yoyogi: The other dogs are tiny. I will play very gently.
data.tk_lines.dobie.asakusa: A big gate with a big lantern. I approve. It looks well guarded.
data.tk_lines.dobie.odaiba: A cool sea breeze. I would like a coat. Then a long walk.
data.tk_lines.dobie.shibuya: The crossing is busy. I will lead you across. Stay close to my shoulder.
data.tk_lines.dobie.tokyotower: A tall red tower. Very upright. I respect that.
data.tk_lines.dobie.ueno: A quiet pond path. I will walk it first and report back. All clear.
data.tk_lines.dobie.yoyogi: Twenty dogs, one fence. I checked the fence. Then I made friends.
data.tk_lines.frenchie.asakusa: A bench by the temple. Good bench. I sit.
data.tk_lines.frenchie.odaiba: Hot sand, flat face. Shade and water, please.
data.tk_lines.frenchie.shibuya: Big crossing. Short legs. I will take my time. *snort*
data.tk_lines.frenchie.tokyotower: Very tall. I will look at it from down here, lying flat.
data.tk_lines.frenchie.ueno: Shady tree, soft grass. Wake me when it is time to go.
data.tk_lines.frenchie.yoyogi: I will sit by the fence and watch. That is my sport.
data.tk_lines.golden.asakusa: A giant red lantern! I would like to fetch it. Gently.
data.tk_lines.golden.odaiba: The sea! The bridge! A ball! Everything is wonderful!
data.tk_lines.golden.shibuya: Everybody is crossing! Hello everybody! Hello, Hachikō!
data.tk_lines.golden.tokyotower: A tower! Can I fetch the tower? I can try.
data.tk_lines.golden.ueno: Ducks! Swan boats! A pond! Best day!
data.tk_lines.golden.yoyogi: SO MANY DOGS. I love all of them. I love the fence.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.asakusa: Long street, long legs, long nose over every stall.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.odaiba: A whole beach for a sprint. Then the whole bridge to look at.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.shibuya: I could cross that in two strides. I will walk it with you instead.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.tokyotower: A tall, thin, elegant thing. A tower after my own heart.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.ueno: I found the softest patch of grass in Tokyo. I am upside down on it.
data.tk_lines.greyhound.yoyogi: A big lawn! ZOOM. ZOOM. ...okay, nap time.
data.tk_lines.gsd.asakusa: Lots of people at the gate. I am on duty, politely.
data.tk_lines.gsd.odaiba: Long beach, long patrol. Paws only, no swimming here.
data.tk_lines.gsd.shibuya: Busy crossing. I will keep the pack together. Stay close, everyone.
data.tk_lines.gsd.tokyotower: From up there you could see everything. I like seeing everything.
data.tk_lines.gsd.ueno: Ducks on the pond, picnics on the grass. All in order.
data.tk_lines.gsd.yoyogi: Twenty dogs, one fence. I have checked the whole fence.
data.tk_lines.husky.asakusa: A quiet temple. I will howl quietly. awoo.
data.tk_lines.husky.odaiba: The sea breeze is cool. Finally something for my coat.
data.tk_lines.husky.shibuya: AWOO, Hachikō! That is a howl of respect.
data.tk_lines.husky.tokyotower: At night it glows like the northern lights. Almost.
data.tk_lines.husky.ueno: The pond is calm. I will sing to it. awoo, pond.
data.tk_lines.husky.yoyogi: Every dog here gets a howl. AWOO. AWOO. AWOO.
data.tk_lines.lab.asakusa: Snack street! Sweet potato! Rice crackers! I am being very polite. Very.
data.tk_lines.lab.odaiba: The sea! The sand! A ball! This is the best beach in Tokyo!
data.tk_lines.lab.shibuya: Hello, everybody! Hello, Hachikō! Does anybody have a snack?
data.tk_lines.lab.tokyotower: A tower! Can I fetch the tower? I cannot. I will fetch the view.
data.tk_lines.lab.ueno: A pond! I will wade in up to my elbows. Just a little.
data.tk_lines.lab.yoyogi: So many dogs! So many balls! Best day! Again! Best day!
data.tk_lines.malamute.asakusa: A quiet temple. I will woo quietly. woo.
data.tk_lines.malamute.odaiba: The sea breeze is cool. Finally, something for this coat. Woo.
data.tk_lines.malamute.shibuya: Woo-woo, Hachikō! That is a big hello for a famous dog.
data.tk_lines.malamute.tokyotower: At night it glows. I will woo at it. It does not mind.
data.tk_lines.malamute.ueno: The pond is calm. I will tell it about snow. Woo.
data.tk_lines.malamute.yoyogi: Every dog here will hear my story. Woo. It is a long one.
data.tk_lines.maltese.asakusa: Old temple, old lanterns, a small white lady. I fit right in.
data.tk_lines.maltese.odaiba: The sea wind lifts the silk. Elegant, but I would like a clip.
data.tk_lines.maltese.shibuya: So many feet. I will watch from your arms, with the fringe flowing.
data.tk_lines.maltese.tokyotower: A very tall tower and a very small dog. We nod politely.
data.tk_lines.maltese.ueno: A shady bench by the pond. I will sit and look lovely.
data.tk_lines.maltese.yoyogi: A big lawn and big dogs. I will float through, very softly.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.asakusa: A calm old temple. I like calm old things. I am one.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.odaiba: Cool sea breeze on a big warm dog. Lovely.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.shibuya: So many people. I will lean on you until they pass.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.tokyotower: A very big tower. A very big nap under it, maybe.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.ueno: A shady tree and soft grass. I am not moving for a while.
data.tk_lines.mastiff.yoyogi: I will watch the play from right here. Watching is a sport.
data.tk_lines.minpin.asakusa: The lantern is as big as a house. I am as brave as a house. Nearly.
data.tk_lines.minpin.odaiba: The breeze is chilly. My coat and I are ready. Zoom!
data.tk_lines.minpin.shibuya: The crossing is huge and I am quick. Watch me prance through the gaps.
data.tk_lines.minpin.tokyotower: A very tall tower. I did a very tall prance about it.
data.tk_lines.minpin.ueno: Swan boats! I will race one. I lose. I race it again.
data.tk_lines.minpin.yoyogi: Big dogs everywhere. High knees! I am the fastest one here.
data.tk_lines.mutt.asakusa: A lucky lantern. I already feel lucky. I have you.
data.tk_lines.mutt.odaiba: I found a shell on a city beach. It is for you.
data.tk_lines.mutt.shibuya: Hachikō waited for his person. I would wait for you too.
data.tk_lines.mutt.tokyotower: It is a very tall tower. I like the view of you better.
data.tk_lines.mutt.ueno: Ducks on the pond. Can we sit here a while?
data.tk_lines.mutt.yoyogi: Lots of dogs. Can I stay near you while I say hello?
data.tk_lines.pitbull.asakusa: Snack street! Nice people! A big lantern! All my favourite things!
data.tk_lines.pitbull.odaiba: Sea! Sand! Bridge! You! Everything is good! Wiggle!
data.tk_lines.pitbull.shibuya: So many people to say hello to! I will wiggle at every one!
data.tk_lines.pitbull.tokyotower: A giant red tower! I will wag at it. It looks so happy to see me.
data.tk_lines.pitbull.ueno: Ducks! A pond! A picnic! Can I hug the picnic? The picnic says yes!
data.tk_lines.pitbull.yoyogi: A whole lawn of new friends! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! Hello!
data.tk_lines.pom.asakusa: A lantern as big as a house! I am as big as a lantern bow.
data.tk_lines.pom.odaiba: Little paws, big beach. Spin, spin, spin!
data.tk_lines.pom.shibuya: So many feet! I am small, so I go between them. Yip!
data.tk_lines.pom.tokyotower: That tower is very tall. I did a spin about it.
data.tk_lines.pom.ueno: A duck said hello. I did a spin back. Yip!
data.tk_lines.pom.yoyogi: Big dogs everywhere. I will do a happy spin to say hello.
data.tk_lines.poodle.asakusa: A thousand years old. Older than my haircut. Barely.
data.tk_lines.poodle.odaiba: Sand in the curls. I will be brave. For the view.
data.tk_lines.poodle.shibuya: A famous crossing. I will cross it beautifully.
data.tk_lines.poodle.tokyotower: A tower with style. Red and white. Very tasteful.
data.tk_lines.poodle.ueno: The swan boats are very elegant. Almost as elegant as me.
data.tk_lines.poodle.yoyogi: The other dogs run around. I prefer to be admired.
data.tk_lines.pug.asakusa: The snack street smells amazing. snort snort snort.
data.tk_lines.pug.odaiba: Warm sand, cool breeze. A pug paradise. snort.
data.tk_lines.pug.shibuya: Too many steps for one crossing. Carry me? snort.
data.tk_lines.pug.tokyotower: I looked at the tower. Very nice. Can we sit now?
data.tk_lines.pug.ueno: A bench by the pond. My favourite kind of view. snort.
data.tk_lines.pug.yoyogi: I came to the dog run to lie down. In public.
data.tk_lines.samoyed.asakusa: The lantern is red and I am white. We look great together.
data.tk_lines.samoyed.odaiba: Too warm for me, but the sea breeze is a good friend.
data.tk_lines.samoyed.shibuya: Hello, Hachikō! Hello, Tokyo! Everyone gets a smile.
data.tk_lines.samoyed.tokyotower: At night it sparkles. I sparkle too, a bit.
data.tk_lines.samoyed.ueno: The pond breeze is cool on my fluff. Woo!
data.tk_lines.samoyed.yoyogi: So many friends to smile at. Woo-woo!
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.asakusa: Lanterns, stalls and incense. Everything is in order. The eyebrows approve.
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.odaiba: Sea breeze in the beard. I am a very windy philosopher.
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.shibuya: Thousands of people, one crossing. I have notes. A lot of notes.
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.tokyotower: A very tall thing. I will keep watch on it from here.
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.ueno: A duck looked at me. I looked back. We are even.
data.tk_lines.schnauzer.yoyogi: Twenty dogs. I will report on each one. The beard is ready.
data.tk_lines.shiba.asakusa: That lantern is bigger than our house. I approve of big things.
data.tk_lines.shiba.odaiba: Sand in my curl again. Tokyo sand, though. Very fancy.
data.tk_lines.shiba.shibuya: Hachikō was a very loyal dog. I am also loyal. When I feel like it.
data.tk_lines.shiba.tokyotower: A tall red tower. Tall, proud, a bit orange. Like me.
data.tk_lines.shiba.ueno: Swan boats on the pond. I could steer one. I choose not to.
data.tk_lines.shiba.yoyogi: A dog run full of strangers. I will pretend not to care. I care a little.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.asakusa: A bench by the temple. A shady one. I will sit here for a few hours.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.odaiba: Hot sand, flat face. Shade and water, please. Then a nap.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.shibuya: So many steps for one crossing. Carry me, please. I will wave.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.tokyotower: Very tall. I will look at it from down here, on the cool floor.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.ueno: A soft patch of shade. Wake me if the picnic needs a taste tester.
data.tk_lines.shihtzu.yoyogi: I came to the dog run to lie down. The lawn is nice for that.
data.tk_lines.spitz.asakusa: A red lantern and a white dog. It is a perfect photo.
data.tk_lines.spitz.odaiba: Sand on my white coat. Someone will brush it. Right?
data.tk_lines.spitz.shibuya: A famous crossing! Everybody watch me cross it. Pose!
data.tk_lines.spitz.tokyotower: Red and white, like a show ring ribbon. I approve.
data.tk_lines.spitz.ueno: A white dog by a blue pond. It is a perfect photo.
data.tk_lines.spitz.yoyogi: A lawn full of dogs. I am the fluffiest one here. Probably.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.asakusa: A thousand years of style. My cousin the Miniature Poodle would love it.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.odaiba: Sand in the topknot. I will be brave. For the view.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.shibuya: A famous crossing. I will cross it in a long, graceful line.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.tokyotower: A tall, slim, elegant tower. We have a lot in common.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.ueno: Swan boats on the pond. Elegant! We are in good company.
data.tk_lines.stdpoodle.yoyogi: A lawn this big deserves one beautiful gallop. Then a trick for the crowd.
data.tk_lines.westie.asakusa: The snack street smells amazing! I will march along it like a tiny white chrysanthemum!
data.tk_lines.westie.odaiba: Sand! A whole beach of it! I am home!
data.tk_lines.westie.shibuya: So many feet! I am small and white and I will go through all of them!
data.tk_lines.westie.tokyotower: Under the tower looks like good digging. I will check. Just in case.
data.tk_lines.westie.ueno: A flowerbed by the pond. I am not digging. I am inspecting. With paws.
data.tk_lines.westie.yoyogi: A dog run with soft ground! I will dig a very polite hole.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.asakusa: A beautiful temple. The silk and the lanterns match. I approve.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.odaiba: The sea wind is hard on silk. Hold me and I will look at the view.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.shibuya: A famous crossing. I will cross it on your arm. Like a queen.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.tokyotower: A tall red tower. I am small and golden. We look very good together.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.ueno: A swan boat. A pond. A bench. Put me on the bench, please.
data.tk_lines.yorkie.yoyogi: Big dogs. I will strut right through. They will make way.
data.tk_ueno.hanami.1: A blanket under the cherry blossoms. Petals land on every nose. +8 Happiness for the pack.
data.tk_ueno.momiji.1: Red maple leaves crunch under every paw. +8 Happiness for the pack.
data.tk_ueno.pond.1: A quiet sit by Shinobazu pond, watching the ducks. +8 Happiness for the pack.

data.toys.plush_ghost.note: Shake: a floppy ghost to shake and carry about. +Happiness, a little Bond.
data.toys.plush_penguin.note: Nap buddy: a round soft penguin to tuck in with. +10% nap Energy.

data.toys.rope_mummy.note: Shake: a rope toy wrapped in soft cream cloth. +Happiness, a little Bond.

data.toys.squeaky_bat.note: Squeeze: a soft purple bat that squeaks. +Happiness.
data.toys.squeaky_duck.note: Squeeze: +10 Happiness. The neighbours love it (no).

data.toys.squeaky_pumpkin.note: Squeak: a soft pumpkin that squeaks when pounced. +Happiness.
data.toys.squeaky_snowman.note: Squeeze: a soft little snowman in a bobble hat that squeaks. +Happiness.
data.toys.treat_cone.note: Lick: a treat cone to lick clean, slowly. Calm +Happiness.

data.wx_lines.husky.dawn: AWOO! The sun is up! Everyone wake up!
data.wx_lines.husky.hot: *pant* I was built for snow, not this.
data.wx_lines.husky.night: AWOO at the moon. Then nap. Then AWOO.
data.wx_lines.husky.rain: AWOO. This is not snow. I demand snow.
data.wx_lines.husky.snow: Snow! But my fancy coat is wet. A sweater would be nice. AWOO.
data.wx_lines.husky.warm: SNOW! THIS IS MY MOMENT! AWOOOOO!
data.wx_lines.lab.coat: Coat on! Splash! Still a duck! Still hoping for dinner!
data.wx_lines.lab.dawn: Morning! Is it breakfast? It is breakfast! I knew it!
data.wx_lines.lab.hot: *pant pant* Water! A pool! A lake! Any water, please!
data.wx_lines.lab.night: *yawn* Best day. Can tomorrow have more balls?
data.wx_lines.lab.rain: RAIN! Puddles! I am a duck now! Is it dinner?
data.wx_lines.lab.snow: Snow! I will eat it. It is cold! I will eat more!
data.wx_lines.lab.warm: Sweater and snow! A happy, warm snow lab! Fetch?
data.wx_lines.malamute.coat: Coat on over my coat. Woo. I look silly and I am dry.
data.wx_lines.malamute.dawn: Woo-woo! Morning! I have a lot to say about it!
data.wx_lines.malamute.hot: *pant* A thick coat on a warm day. Shade and water, please. Woo.
data.wx_lines.malamute.night: Woo. Goodnight, moon. Woo-woo. Goodnight, you.
data.wx_lines.malamute.rain: Woo. Rain. This is not snow. Woo-woo. I am complaining.
data.wx_lines.malamute.snow: SNOW! Woo-woo-WOO! Now we are talking! Mostly me!
data.wx_lines.malamute.warm: Sweater and snow? Too much coat. Worth it. Woo!
data.wx_lines.maltese.coat: Raincoat on. The fringe is saved. The day is saved.
data.wx_lines.maltese.dawn: Good morning. Please brush the fringe. Gently.
data.wx_lines.maltese.hot: *pant* A long white coat in the sun. Shade and water, please.
data.wx_lines.maltese.night: *yawn* A small white cloud settles down. Goodnight.
data.wx_lines.maltese.rain: Rain on the silk. Absolutely not. Indoors, with a towel.
data.wx_lines.maltese.snow: Snow on the long hair. Cold and soggy. A sweater, please.
data.wx_lines.maltese.warm: Sweater and snow. I will float through it. Elegantly.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.coat: Coat on. I am a very dry hill.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.dawn: Morning. *slow blink* Breakfast is ready in my head.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.hot: *pant drool pant* Big dogs feel the heat. Shade, water and a towel, please.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.rain: Rain. I will stay in. The sofa will not mind.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.snow: Cold nose, warm heart. A sweater would make it fair.
data.wx_lines.mastiff.warm: Sweater and snow. Gentle snow. Gentle me.
data.wx_lines.minpin.coat: Coat on. Still prancing. High knees in puddles.
data.wx_lines.minpin.dawn: GOOD MORNING. I have already done three laps of the room.
data.wx_lines.minpin.hot: Warm and sunny. A tiny dog needs a drink and shade. Then I zoom.
data.wx_lines.minpin.night: *yawn* A tiny yawn. A tiny snore. A tiny blanket, please.
data.wx_lines.minpin.rain: Each raindrop is a personal insult. I am staying in.
data.wx_lines.minpin.snow: My belly is in the snow. It is a disaster. Sweater, now.
data.wx_lines.minpin.warm: Sweater on! Now I can prance in the snow. High knees!
data.wx_lines.mutt.coat: Thank you for keeping me dry. You are the best.
data.wx_lines.mutt.dawn: Good morning. I waited for you. Hi.
data.wx_lines.mutt.hot: It is warm. Can I sit in your shadow?
data.wx_lines.mutt.rain: I do not mind the rain if you are here.
data.wx_lines.mutt.snow: Brr. Could I borrow something warm? Only if it is okay.
data.wx_lines.mutt.warm: Toasty and snowy! Can we play?
data.wx_lines.pitbull.coat: Raincoat on! A dry, wiggly goofball in a coat!
data.wx_lines.pitbull.dawn: Good morning! You are here! I am wiggling! All of me!
data.wx_lines.pitbull.hot: Phew, warm. Shade and water, please. Then more wiggling.
data.wx_lines.pitbull.night: *yawn* Best day. Can I sleep on your feet?
data.wx_lines.pitbull.rain: Rain! Puddles! Wiggle wiggle splash! ...oh, my coat is thin. Towel?
data.wx_lines.pitbull.snow: Snow! So fun! So cold! Short fur, big heart. Sweater, please!
data.wx_lines.pitbull.warm: Sweater and snow! The best of both! Wiggle!
data.wx_lines.pom.coat: Tiny raincoat. Big feelings. Dry fluff.
data.wx_lines.pom.dawn: YIP! Good morning! I am awake and in charge!
data.wx_lines.pom.hot: *pant* Tiny dogs get hot fast. Shade and a drink, please.
data.wx_lines.pom.rain: Each raindrop is bigger than my paw. I am staying in.
data.wx_lines.pom.snow: Snow is up to my chin. Yip! Sweater, please.
data.wx_lines.pom.warm: Sweater on. I am a small fluffy snowball.
data.wx_lines.poodle.coat: A raincoat. Very chic. The curls survive.
data.wx_lines.poodle.dawn: Good morning. I have been awake for hours. Thinking.
data.wx_lines.poodle.hot: Too hot for curls. I will be elegant in the shade.
data.wx_lines.poodle.rain: Rain flattens the curls. I need a moment.
data.wx_lines.poodle.snow: The curls are not a coat. A sweater, please.
data.wx_lines.poodle.warm: Sweater on. Now I am a stylish snowball.
data.wx_lines.pug.coat: Raincoat on. I look like a tiny dry potato.
data.wx_lines.pug.dawn: Morning? Already? Five more hours. snort.
data.wx_lines.pug.hot: *snort pant snort* Flat faces do not do heat. Shade, please.
data.wx_lines.pug.rain: Rain. No. I will be indoors. snort.
data.wx_lines.pug.snow: Cold nose. Cold toes. Cold everything. Sweater?
data.wx_lines.pug.warm: Toasty sweater. I could nap in the snow. Do not let me.
data.wx_lines.samoyed.coat: A raincoat on a cloud. Very sensible.
data.wx_lines.samoyed.dawn: Woo-woo! Good morning! I missed you all night!
data.wx_lines.samoyed.hot: *pant* Too much sun for this much fluff. Shade and water, please.
data.wx_lines.samoyed.rain: Wet fluff is heavy fluff. I am a soggy cloud.
data.wx_lines.samoyed.snow: SNOW! This is my weather! Woo-woo!
data.wx_lines.samoyed.warm: Sweater AND snow? I will be too toasty. Worth it.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.coat: Coat on. The beard stays out. The beard has standards.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.dawn: GOOD MORNING. I heard the first bird. I have notes.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.hot: *pant* Warm day, wiry coat. Shade and water, please.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.night: *yawn* All quiet. Eyebrows down. Not off.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.rain: Rain. Wet beard. Wet eyebrows. I will report this to the sky.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.snow: Snow in the beard. Cold! Sweater, please. I will guard from inside.
data.wx_lines.schnauzer.warm: Sweater and snow. Beard in the wind, nose in the air.
data.wx_lines.shiba.coat: Behold. A dog who does not get wet. Bow.
data.wx_lines.shiba.hot: Too hot to be this dramatic. I will try.
data.wx_lines.shiba.rain: Rain? On ME? I would like to speak to the manager of the sky.
data.wx_lines.shiba.snow: Cold. Unacceptable. A sweater, please. Now.
data.wx_lines.shiba.warm: Snow is beneath me. I will zoom across it anyway.
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.coat: Raincoat on. The top-knot stays dry. Mostly. *snort*
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.dawn: Morning? Already? The top-knot needs five more hours.
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.hot: *snort pant* Short nose and warm sun. Shade and water, please.
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.rain: Rain. No thank you. I will be on the sofa. Zzz.
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.snow: Cold nose, cold toes. Sweater, please. Then a nap.
data.wx_lines.shihtzu.warm: Sweater and snow. I could nap in it. Do not let me.
data.wx_lines.spitz.coat: Raincoat on. The fluff stays dry. We are saved.
data.wx_lines.spitz.dawn: Good morning! Look, my fluff is already perfect!
data.wx_lines.spitz.hot: *pant* All this white fluff and all this sun. Shade, please.
data.wx_lines.spitz.rain: Wet fluff is sad fluff. I am a small damp cloud.
data.wx_lines.spitz.snow: Snow! I match the snow! Nobody can find me!
data.wx_lines.spitz.warm: Sweater and snow. I am a fluffy snowball in a sweater.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.coat: A raincoat on long legs. Very chic. The curls are safe.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.dawn: Good morning. I have already planned the day. It has tricks.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.hot: Too warm for curls. I will be elegant in the shade, with water.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.night: *yawn* Even clever dogs need rest. I learned three tricks in my dreams.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.rain: Rain on curls. The big poodle needs a moment. A long moment.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.snow: Long legs in deep snow. Elegant, but cold. A sweater, please.
data.wx_lines.stdpoodle.warm: Sweater and snow. A stylish, leggy snowman.
data.wx_lines.westie.coat: Raincoat on. The mud cannot get me. Probably.
data.wx_lines.westie.dawn: Morning! The garden is out there! Let me at it!
data.wx_lines.westie.hot: *pant* Warm. I will dig a cool hole in the shade. Good plan.
data.wx_lines.westie.rain: Rain! Mud! I will be a very dirty white dog soon.
data.wx_lines.westie.snow: Snow! White on white! You cannot see me! Brr. Sweater?
data.wx_lines.westie.warm: Sweater on. I will dig a snow hole. A cosy one.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.coat: Tiny raincoat on. The silk is safe. I am a small waterproof queen.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.dawn: Good morning. I have been awake for hours. Brush me.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.hot: *pant* Tiny dogs get hot too. Shade and a drink, please.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.night: *yawn* Tiny yawn. The bow stays on. Goodnight.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.rain: Rain on silk! No. No no no. Carry me. Indoors.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.snow: Snow is as tall as me. Sweater. Now. Also carry me.
data.wx_lines.yorkie.warm: Sweater on. I am a small, silky snowball with a bow.
dd.c_chatty0: Woo-woo. That was the short version.
dd.c_grand1: Tomorrow, more of the same, please.
dd.d_empty: No pages yet. Spend a day together and {name} will write the first one.
dd.d_learned: I learned {list}! I am a genius.
dd.d_walk: Walks today: {list}. I sniffed every single thing.
dd.fam_0: {pup} found the sunniest spot in our garden and naps there every afternoon. Thank you for our best friend.
dd.fam_1: {pup} learned to sit for breakfast. Then for lunch. Then for no reason at all. We are very proud.
dd.fam_2: We walked by the river today. {pup} said hello to every duck, very politely.
dd.fam_3: {pup} has a favourite toy now: a squeaky carrot. It squeaks all day and we love it anyway.
dd.fam_4: {pup} met the cat next door. They sat and looked at each other for a long time. Friends now, we think.
dd.fam_5: {pup} sends a muddy paw print and a big wag. We hope your dogs are well.
dd.news_0: The Splash Pool has a new rubber duck. Nobody knows who brought it. The duck is not telling.
dd.news_1: Baker Bea is testing a new dog biscuit: plain oats and pumpkin. The pigeons are jealous.
dd.news_2: The Dog Park bench was painted blue. Please let it dry before you sit. That means you, {dog}.
dd.news_3: Pip says the carrots are growing faster this week. Pip says that every week.
dd.news_4: A very polite squirrel was seen on Market Street. It looked at everything and bought nothing.
dd.news_5: The Training Ground has a new flag by the tunnel. It is yellow and it flaps. Some dogs are suspicious of it.
dd.news_6: Mrs. Plum lost a ball of wool. If your dog finds it, she says it is a gift now.
dd.news_7: A note from the vet: fresh water every day, shade on hot days, and a lot of love. That is the whole secret.
dd.news_ps: Gerald, who reads every notice board twice
dd.o_bouncy0: Dear diary! BEST DAY EVER! Again!
dd.o_bouncy1: Dear diary! So much happened! Here it is, fast:
dd.o_chatty0: Dear diary! Woo! Let me tell you everything.
dd.o_chatty1: Dear diary. I have a lot to say. As always.
dd.o_cuddly0: Dear diary. I was with my human all day. Perfect.
dd.o_cuddly1: Dear diary. Lots of pats today, and lots of love back.
dd.o_foodie1: Dear diary. First the snacks, then everything else.
dd.o_grand0: Dear diary. Today went as I planned. Mostly.
dd.o_grand1: Dear diary. My human did very well today. I am proud of them.
dd.o_sleepy0: Dear diary. I woke up. It was worth it.
dd.o_sleepy1: Dear diary. Between naps, some things happened.

fest.harvest_packed_up: The Harvest Stall has packed up. Baker Bea says thank you for the pumpkin business.

fest.paraded_lap: Paraded today. Come back tomorrow for another lap.

fest.poor_winter: Not enough coins. Walks pay well, and the carob will stay warm.

fest.smell_carob: It smells of oats and warm carob.
fest.smell_pumpkin: It smells of pumpkin. Everything does.
fest.snag: The festival hit a small snag. Try again in a moment.

fest.wearing_rosette: {name} is wearing the Parade Rosette. Very proud.
fest.winter_blurb: Warm treats, winter clothes and decorations.
fest.winter_intro: Warm treats, winter clothes and yard decorations, for coins, until the end of February. You have {coins} Paw Coins.
fest.winter_packed_up: Baker Bea has packed up the Winter Stall. See you in the spring, with flowers.
fest.wrap_leaf: Baker Bea wraps it in a paper leaf.
fest.wrap_snow: Baker Bea wraps it in snowflake paper.

fetch.legend: {name} is a fetch legend. Statues are being considered.
fetch.pack_ran: {names} ran along and got the Happiness and Bond too.

ff.a_show: Mrs. Plum shows a pose card. Remember the tricks, then tap them in the same order.

ff.a_wash: The Tanakas' dog is visiting. Scrub, rinse and towel them dry with the bath tools.

ff.busy: {name} is busy right now. Try the Fun Fair in a moment.

ff.h_paper_p: Tap when your dog is by a door to drop off the paper.
ff.h_seek: Watch the box with the toy. Then follow your dog's nose and tap a box.
ff.h_seek_click: Click the box, or press its number.
ff.h_seek_watch: The toy goes under a box. Keep your eye on it.

ff.h_show_do: Your turn: tap the tricks in order.
ff.h_show_look: Mrs. Plum holds up the pose card. Remember it.
ff.h_show_peek: Mrs. Plum smiles and shows the card again.
ff.h_w2: Step 2: hold to rinse the suds away.

ff.h_wash_p: Rub the dog with a finger to scrub. Hold to rinse. Rub again to towel dry.

ff.paper_joe: Grandpa Joe pops that one in.
ff.pc_all: Everyone who enters gets a ribbon. A new contest starts on Monday.

ff.r_show: {name} posed {n} of {r} cards. The crowd clapped.
ff.r_wash: {name} watched the whole bath and approved. The Tanakas are delighted.
ff.r_wash_part: Nearly done! {dog} is mostly clean and very happy.

ff.stall_dog: {name} greeted every neighbour with a wag.
